_comment: M4 bullying events (Kimi C). Target events gate on social_arc (actor is the target); observer events gate on a bully edge the actor sees but is not the target of (content uses social_kind to a bound bully + not the arc). All non-graphic, no slurs, target never blamed; every event offers >=2 real responses; tell_someone always works (no rng gate). Responses resolve through C's apply_bullying_response table (bullying.json).

events.title: The Note
events.text: Someone has taped a cruel note to my locker. {person:bully} is laughing at the end of the corridor.

choices.label: Tell a teacher
choices.outcome_text: I took the note to a teacher and told them everything. It stopped being my secret to carry alone.

choices.label: Tell them to stop
choices.outcome_text: I told the note-taper to stop, voice shaking and words steady, and walked away before my courage ran out.

choices.label: Take the long way round
choices.outcome_text: I took the long way round to class to dodge the note-taper, and hated that I had to.

events.title: The Group Chat
events.text: A group chat I am in has turned on me, and {person:bully} keeps adding fuel whenever it dies down.

choices.label: Show a trusted adult
choices.outcome_text: I showed the group chat to a trusted adult and we dealt with it together; the chat went very quiet very fast.

choices.label: Leave the chat and walk away
choices.outcome_text: I left the group chat that had turned on me and muted the noise; my phone felt lighter for it.

choices.label: Reply once, firmly
choices.outcome_text: I replied once in the chat, firmly and without insults, and then put my phone in a drawer like a professional.

events.title: The Shake-Down
events.text: {person:bully} has started waiting by the school gates, and today they have asked, very casually, for my lunch money.

choices.label: Report it straight away
choices.outcome_text: I reported the lunch-money business straight away, and an adult was at the gates the very next morning.

choices.label: Refuse loudly, where people can see
choices.outcome_text: I refused to hand over my lunch money loudly enough for everyone to hear, and something in the balance shifted.

choices.label: Take the side gate
choices.outcome_text: I gave up my lunch money at the gates and took the side gate the rest of the week, quietly furious about it.

events.title: My Seat, Taken
events.text: {person:bully} has taken my usual seat in every class this week and seems to find my irritation a kind of sport.

choices.label: Ask for it back, plainly
choices.outcome_text: I asked for my seat back plainly, no drama, and held the stare until the joke stopped being fun.

choices.label: Take another seat
choices.outcome_text: I took another seat all week and let the seat-thief have the victory, saving my energy for better fights.

choices.label: Mention it to the teacher
choices.outcome_text: I mentioned the seat business to the teacher, who moved the seating plan and the whole thing quietly ended.

events.title: The Thaw
events.text: Things with {person:bully} have been quiet for a while, and today they were almost polite to me in the corridor.

choices.label: Offer a truce
choices.outcome_text: I offered the cold-war bully a truce over a shared assignment, and we ended up laughing about nothing in particular.

choices.label: Let it fade on its own
choices.outcome_text: I let the thaw with the former bully happen on its own time, polite nods slowly becoming actual greetings.

events.title: Someone Else's Note
events.text: I watched {person:bully} tape a cruel note to another kid's locker, and the kid saw me seeing it.

choices.label: Check on the kid
choices.outcome_text: I found the kid from the locker note at lunch and sat with them; it cost me nothing and maybe helped a little.

choices.label: Report what you saw
choices.outcome_text: I reported exactly what I saw on the locker, and told the kid afterwards so they did not feel alone in it.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.outcome_text: I stayed out of the locker-note business and walked past fast, then thought about it more than I wanted to.

events.title: The Pile-On
events.text: {person:bully} is mocking a classmate at lunch and the table is laughing along, waiting to see who joins in.

choices.label: Change the subject loudly
choices.outcome_text: I changed the subject loudly at the lunch table and the pile-on lost its audience before it got properly started.

choices.label: Laugh along uncomfortably
choices.outcome_text: I laughed along at the lunch-table mockery and felt smaller with every laugh, which was not a fair trade.
